mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) coupled with an increase in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals a demand-side slowdown with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases and CPIAUCSL increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases for 2 quarters, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
